data_objects.name: basketball_play_by_play_events
data_objects.meaning: Basketball game play-by-play events with event codes, period and clock fields, team-oriented narrative descriptions, and score state.
data_objects.notes: Blank description and score cells mean that the corresponding event has no text or score update in that field.

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.meaning: Identifier of the basketball game containing the event.

variables.name: EVENTNUM
variables.meaning: Event number within GAME_ID, used as an event-level identifier and approximate sequence field.

variables.name: EVENTMSGTYPE
variables.meaning: Integer-coded broad event-message type; the codebook is not supplied.

variables.name: EVENTMSGACTIONTYPE
variables.meaning: Integer-coded event action subtype; the codebook is not supplied.

variables.name: PERIOD
variables.meaning: Ordinal game period containing the event.

variables.name: WCTIMESTRING
variables.meaning: Wall-clock display time associated with the event.

variables.name: PCTIMESTRING
variables.meaning: Period countdown clock at the event, formatted as minutes and seconds remaining.

variables.name: HOMEDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Play-by-play narrative attached to the home team side of an event.

variables.name: NEUTRALDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Play-by-play narrative field for events not assigned to either team side.

variables.name: VISITORDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Play-by-play narrative attached to the visiting team side of an event.

variables.name: SCORE
variables.meaning: Two-team score state encoded as a hyphen-separated pair; side ordering is not labeled in the CSV.

variables.name: SCOREMARGIN
variables.meaning: Signed score-margin text in points, with tied states encoded as TIE.

structure.description: Each row is one game event. GAME_ID and EVENTNUM together form the event-level candidate key.
PERIOD and PCTIMESTRING express game chronology. EVENTNUM is sequence-like, but physical row order contains local event-number reversals and should not be treated as strictly increasing.
Home, neutral, and visitor description fields are parallel narrative slots for the same event; SCORE and SCOREMARGIN carry state only when supplied on that event row.

uncertainties: The EVENTMSGTYPE and EVENTMSGACTIONTYPE code dictionaries are not included.
The team ordering in SCORE, sign convention in SCOREMARGIN, wall-clock timezone, and calendar date are not explicitly documented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
